product_one_liner.value: Gushwork provides AI marketing agents that help small and midsized businesses generate qualified inbound leads across AI search, Google and paid channels without building a full marketing team.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists pricing starting at $900 per month.

named_customers.notes: Both appear in customer testimonials on the homepage.

employee_band.notes: Based on LinkedIn's listed employee count of 202; this is a profile-based count, not an audited payroll total.

hq_location.notes: Based on the company's primary LinkedIn location; some other sources describe a Delaware headquarters.

eng_blog.notes: The blog contains marketing, SEO and product content; no qualifying pair of engineer-authored product-build posts was found.

public_docs.notes: No public multi-article documentation or help hub was found. A standalone RAG SDK README is available, but it does not meet the specified documentation-hub criterion.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job board lists engineering and other openings, but none has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.value: Claude Sonnet 4 (claude-sonnet-4-20250514), shown in Gushwork's public RAG SDK examples.
model_provider.notes: The SDK examples explicitly select this model; they do not establish the current production model used by every Gushwork marketing agent.

compliance_certs.notes: No certification claims found for the five specified standards. The privacy policy discusses GDPR as applicable law, rather than claiming certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced February 26, 2026; no later round was found.

raised_18mo.notes: The $9 million seed round announced February 26, 2026 falls within the requested window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Account Executive – US Sales posting is available; the board also lists SDR and BDR roles.

launched_6mo.notes: AI Editor launched June 2, 2026, enabling customers to update landing pages using plain-English prompts.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No qualifying dated appointment or departure was verified, and the available leadership information did not establish a complete dated history for the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Named as CRM proficiency examples in an Account Executive posting; this is a hiring signal, not confirmation that all three are deployed internally.
